# Feature: name

- Status: PROPOSED
- Owner:
- Roadmap phase:
- Affected modules:
- Requirements: `REQ-...`
- Applicable ADRs: `ADR-...`
- Open questions involved: `OQ-...` (must be resolved or explicitly assumed)

## Objective

What user or engine need does this feature cover?

## Out of scope

What will not be handled in this feature.

## Expected behavior

Describe the observable behaviors, including errors and edge cases. Restate every default value, range, state and order of operations the batch needs, with the ADR it comes from: an implementer must not have to open an ADR to find a value.

## Envisaged APIs / contracts

Responsibilities and interactions; the canonical type names of ADR-0037 that apply. Java signatures are proposed by the batch under `docs/conventions.md` and reviewed in its pull request.

## Batches (order)

Numbered list of small batches, each with the requirements it covers.

## Lifecycle and concurrency

Creation, use, shutdown, closing, calling thread and resource ownership.

## Units and Android/DEX compatibility

Units used (meters, seconds, m/s, m/s²). Java APIs and dependencies introduced, and the result of the Android compatibility check (see `docs/android-compatibility.md`).

## Dependencies

Required modules and forbidden dependencies.

## Tests

- Unit tests:
- Contract tests:
- Integration tests:
- Platform/performance tests:

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Requirements covered.
- [ ] API reviewed in the pull request.
- [ ] Automated tests added and passing.
- [ ] Complete Javadoc.
- [ ] Headless example, `api-index.md` entry, traceability matrix, `docs/features/README.md` and `docs/engine-features.md` (capability bullets and state) updated.
- [ ] No forbidden coupling.
- [ ] Android/DEX compatibility verified.
